reviews.title: Great for older/budget builds
reviews.comment: Works great, got 2 kits for 32gb total and runs well in my Optiplex 5050 SFF for standard use and light gaming. If you have an older/budget build, this ram will do well for you if you grab 2 kits as they are single rank. It is at end of life by Crucial, so upgrading to better ram may be worth it to you. If you’re limited to lower by your CPU and don’t feel like upgrading it tho, this is quality ram
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.title: Works Perfectly / Crucial is Among the Best
reviews.comment: Installed easily and works perfectly in my 2015 Dell XPS 8900 tower. Upgraded from original 8GB to 32GB. Took a while to boot the first time, probably BIOS updating RAM, since then boots & works perfectly. Don't notice any real difference from 8GB to 32GB RAM but not a heavy user, 32GB was overkill for me but didn't cost much more than 16GB so went for it. TL/DR: Working Perfectly! Thanks Crucial!
reviews.author: D. Meyer

reviews.title: Trusted brand, reliable RAM, reasonably priced
reviews.comment: This is the brand recommended by Dell. This memory 2-pack is working perfectly and was a welcome upgrade for an older PC. The price was just right and delivery time was reasonable.

reviews.comment: Did the job. Performance is as advertised. Would buy again if needed.
reviews.author: Nick K

reviews.title: It's fine, I guess?
reviews.comment: Simple enough to install but I'm not sure how well it works. The problem was on my end, I'd forgotten my pc only has 2 slots for RAM. I had 12GB installed already (1 4GB and 1 8GB). Thinking I could squeeze more life out of my rapidly aging pc, I learned it could expand up to 32GB. I bought this set of 2 thinking I'd be up to 28GB. Yeah, no. I could only replace the 4GB stick with one of these from the 2 pack. So, I spent 30 bucks on a 4GB upgrade. I took a star off because this is the second time having Crucial recommend the "wrong" sticks.
reviews.author: Don
